import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
heights = list(map(int, input().split()))

while True:
    changed = False
    for j in range(n - 1):
        if heights[j] + 2 <= heights[j + 1]:
            transfer = (heights[j + 1] - heights[j]) // 2
            heights[j] += transfer
            heights[j + 1] -= transfer
            changed = True

        break
